name: Mussels
siboNotes: Naturally FODMAP-free protein that's well-tolerated in SIBO diets. Cook thoroughly and avoid high-FODMAP seasonings like garlic and onion.
preparationTips: Steam in white wine with fresh herbs instead of garlic and onion
Season with garlic-infused oil (oil only, no garlic pieces) for flavor
Add fresh lemon juice and parsley after cooking
Discard any mussels that don't open during cooking
nutritionalHighlights: Good source of omega-3 fatty acids
